title_sq: Tek Splendor Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt Ne faze Perfundimtare !!!
description_sq: Tek Splendor Residence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt. Objekti eshte ne faza perfundimtare dhe behet i banueshem me muajin mars te vitit te ardhshem.
title_en: At Splendor Residence, a 2+1+2 apartment with a regular floor plan is for sale in the final stage!!!
description_en: At Splendor Residence, 2+1+2 Apartment with Regular Layout is for sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​103.3 m2, is located on the 9th floor, the residence is on the top floor and is organized in the corridor which divides the living room together with the kitchen area, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet, a children's room with access to the balcony and 1 other toilet. The orientation of the apartment is south-east. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, making it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment. The building is in the final stages and will be habitable in March next year.
